SELECT T2.GasStationID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID GROUP BY T2.GasStationID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Amount * T2.Price) DESC LIMIT 1
